name: Huacachina
blurb: Huacachina has appeared in travel conversation only in the last few weeks, from a base of almost nothing. Early posts are enthusiastic but the sample is still small.

positive: Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
Good value compared with last year
negative: Cheap accommodation getting harder to find

quotes.text: Not the easiest place to reach, which is probably why it is still calm.
Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
Second time here and it still feels underrated.
